name: Seeing Through Fog — Adverse Weather Sensor Benchmark
description: Multimodal automotive sensor dataset created by Ulm University, Princeton University, and Mercedes-Benz AG to benchmark perception under extreme weather. Collected over 10,000 km of driving across Northern Europe and in controlled fog chambers. Pairs high-resolution gated near-infrared active cameras with stereo RGB cameras, Velodyne scanning LiDAR, Continental radar, and thermal sensors, offering 12,000 synchronized multimodal driving frames annotated with 2D and 3D bounding boxes in dense fog, rain, and snow, complemented by 1,500 additional controlled fog-chamber measurements.
